corrections.reason: The printed glyph clearly has the Ka'eb right-leg stroke 'ሁ' (ሁነን), preserving the authentic archaic Andemta form.
Both visually on the page and grammatically in Ge'ez (quoting 'ዘጸውዐነ' from Col 3 L12), the initial character is 1st-order 'ጸ' (ጸውዐነ = 'He called us'), not 6th-order 'ጽ'.
Visually the printed characters are 'ትኩላን' (diligence/attentiveness, standard Andemta gloss for Ge'ez 'ጕጕኡ'), where 'ት' and 'ኩ' were misread as 'ች' and 'ኮ'.
The citation for Galatians 5:22 ('ገላት ፡ ፭ ፡ ቍ ፡ ፳፪ ።') uses the abbreviation 'ቍ' (ቍጥር = verse), which was misread as the numeral '፮'.

In the canonical Ge'ez root text of 2 Peter 1:6 (and repeated at the top of the next page 'ወበኢዘምዎ'), the word is 'ለኢዘምዎ' (continental/chastity, lit. 'not fornicating', glossed on L33 as 'ንጽሕናን'), with 3rd-order 'ኢ' and 1st-order 'ዘ'.
